source.title: The efficacy of dapagliflozin combined with hypoglycaemic drugs in treating type 2 diabetes mellitus: meta-analysis of randomised controlled trials

governing_source_execution.literature(1).py: executed as governing structural Pydantic model
governing_source_execution.summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4: governing SEA protocol; filename is v4 although its internal heading says Integrated Compact v3

schema_gaps: The LiteratureAtom schema is primary-literature-oriented and has no dedicated systematic-review/meta-analysis result kind. Review-generated pooled estimates use quantitative_result or subgroup_result with systematic_review_pooled_result/secondary_reported_result tags.
Individual trial findings reproduced in Table 1 were not represented as if Sun et al. generated those primary-study observations.
source_integrity_findings: The abstract reverses the ordering of the two sensitivity-analysis result sets relative to the Results section: the abstract assigns -0.56/-1.11/-2.23 to exclusion of low-quality trials and -0.50/-1.08/-2.08 to exclusion of interim trials, whereas the Results section assigns them in the opposite way.
GRADE Table 2 labels the HbA1c evidence as 3,986 participants from 14 studies, while the narrative Results section states that the HbA1c analysis included 12 randomized trials.
GRADE Table 2 labels the body-weight evidence as 4,008 participants from 14 studies, while the narrative Results section states that the body-weight analysis included 12 randomized trials.

Table 3 prints a fasting-plasma-glucose week coefficient of -0.01 with a 95% confidence interval of 0.004 to 0.012, an interval that is incompatible in sign with the printed point estimate; the Results prose also describes -1.52 as the follow-up-duration coefficient although Table 3 presents -1.52 as the intercept.

The body-weight meta-regression is described as significant with R-squared 1 and p<0.01, while Table 3 prints a week estimate of -0.01 with 95% CI -0.02 to 0.01, which crosses zero; the source does not reconcile the difference.
extraction_limitations: References were preserved as bibliography/task infrastructure and were not atomized.
The five-page supplement was used to reconcile subgroup and sensitivity forest plots; it did not create a second publication identity.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review; no human verification status was fabricated.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
